name: podcast
description: Research any topic and turn it into a verified, two-host, podcast-style MP3 — parallel research agents, claims re-checked against primary sources, a script written for the ear, local text-to-speech, and a whisper round-trip that catches dropped or garbled audio. Works with nothing installed (it writes the script); upgrade voices and QA when you want them.

episodes_dir.title: Episodes folder
episodes_dir.description: Where episodes are written (script, sources, audio).

voice_engine.title: Voice engine
voice_engine.description: auto (use the best installed), none (script only), piper (≈375 MB on disk, fast) or kokoro (better quality, adds a 338 MB model). Nothing downloads until you ask. Change later with: /podcast upgrade voice

qa_level.title: Audio QA level
qa_level.description: auto (use what's installed), none (skip), base (≈575 MB including the transcription runtime), small or medium (larger, more accurate). Checks rendered audio against the script. Change later with: /podcast upgrade qa

telegram_bot.title: Telegram bot name (optional)
telegram_bot.description: Name of a bot in ~/.config/telegram-send/bots.json to deliver episodes to. Leave blank to just save the file locally.

listener_profile.title: Listener profile (optional)
listener_profile.description: Path to a markdown file describing who is listening, so episodes speak to you directly. Leave blank for a neutral audience.
